content_sections.heading: About KVAFSU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University (KVAFSU) has its headquarters at Bidar, and its Veterinary College is at Hebbal, Bengaluru. The JRF post sits in the Department of Veterinary Microbiology, where the Principal Investigator (Professor and Head of the department) runs Phase II of a DBT-funded project on a recombinant G protein-based quantitative ELISA for seromonitoring post-antirabies vaccinal antibody responses in dogs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in a relevant field (Veterinary science / Medical or general microbiology / Virology / Genetics / Molecular biology / Public Health / Life Sciences) from a recognized University / Institute. The notice prefers a minimum of 3 years of research experience, including the following: Rabies diagnosis and surveillance Molecular techniques (isolation of nucleic acids, PCR, Real Time PCR and downstream applications) Characterization of proteins (SDS-PAGE, Western Blot analysis) Bioinformatics analysis, phylogenetic analysis / dendrogram generation Handling genomic databases Mammalian cell culture technique Isolation of viruses, virus neutralization assay Standardisation of versions of ELISA, immunological techniques Epidemiology Laboratory management including maintenance of records, documentation, preparation of reports, management of store operations, computer skills, and experience in preparation of IEC materials The candidate's age must be less than 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF is engaged on a consolidated basis. The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 37,000 plus 27% HRA, which comes to Rs. 46,990 per month. The tenure of the engagement is not specified in the notice. The appointment is terminable at any time without assigning any reason, and the candidate has no right to any permanent employment in the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVAFSU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Email a soft copy of the application to [email protected] latest by 28 November 2026. Fill in the application form given in Annexure-1 of the notification. Attend the interview on 3 December 2026 at 10.00 AM in the chamber of the Dean (Vety), Veterinary College, KVAFSU, Hebbal, Bengaluru-24, with the filled form and enclosures. Produce the original certificates for verification at the interview. Duly filled application form as given in Annexure-1 Necessary enclosures Recent passport size photographs Original certificates (for verification at the interview)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates appear for an interview in the chamber of the Dean (Vety), Veterinary College, KVAFSU, Hebbal, Bengaluru-24 on 3 December 2026 at 10.00 AM. Candidates attend at their own cost. Original certificates are verified at the time of interview.
